messages:
Sam: quick follow-up to the deprecation RFC — can we pick a concrete cadence story for API surface pruning? thinking we need a repeatable pattern teams can follow. :seedling:
Priya: +1. we should standardize phases (announce -> soft-deprecate -> enforced remove). what durations are we comfortable with? 30/60/90? :thinking_face:
Miguel: prefer something like 90d announce, 45d soft, 30d hard. gives customers time but not infinite. also we need a telemetry hook so SDKs can auto-log usage of soon-to-be-deleted fields.
Dana: agree on phases but suggest we call them: "announce", "legacy-mode", "disabled" to avoid legal-y terms. legacy-mode = warning header + tolerated behavior.
Sam: nice. propose we add a header and a lightweight opt-in flag so clients can opt into legacy-mode per-tenant. gateway can honor it for X days.
Priya: about the header: do we invent new header or reuse something existing? we should avoid collisions with downstream proxies.
Miguel: simple header example we discussed:
```
X-Rw-Deprecation: announced=2026-07-01;legacy_until=2026-08-15;id=ARCH-2026-042
```
Gateway will surface it in responses and we can index it in telemetry.
Sam: +1 to that format. metadata fields are small strings. ops-bot: deploy/bot note: can wire in to alerting if a header appears for >10% of traffic.
Dana: rollout playbook thought: 1) RFC + changelog 2) announce to customers + console banner 3) enable telemetry rollout 4) default gateway to soft-deprecate after announce window 5) automatic escalations if usage > threshold 6) hard remove after grace window. short messages in runbook so oncall can follow quickly.
Priya: how do SDKs surface warnings? we can add runtime warning logs and an opt-in deprecationCallback hook in 1.2 SDK release. that way product teams can catch and fix in tests.
Miguel: and add a lint rule for common API uses flagged by our static analyzer — runs in CI and can fail PRs with TODOs referencing the deprecation id.
Sam: ops question: are we comfortable with automatic fallback to a compatibility-serving bucket (slower but tolerant) for legacy clients during legacy-mode?
Dana: yes but gateway should enforce rate limits/quotas for that bucket. otherwise cost explodes.
Priya: we should capture success metrics: % calls still using deprecated field, customer list, latency delta for fallback bucket, error spikes after hard remove. attach to rollout dashboard.
Miguel: suggestion: provide a short-lived transition header for clients to poll: `X-Rw-Dep-Status: legacy` or `X-Rw-Dep-Status: removed`. the console can read that and show a per-tenant status.
Sam: good. also we need a JSON response body shim for critical fields where we can map old->new for a limited time. implement as gateway transform rules keyed by deprecation id. example rule:
```
match: body.userName
map_to: body.customer.display_name
when: legacy_mode && id==ARCH-2026-042
```
this will be limited and audited.
Priya: please add migration notes to the docs with sample diffs and a small test harness teams can run locally to validate.
Dana: runbook includes rollback triggers: if errors spike >5% in 1h or customer complaints >3 in 24h we stall and open a rollback PR. include contact for escalation.
Miguel: minor: choose machine-readable id for each deprecation (ARCH-YYYY-NNN) and include a short human summary. makes automation easier.
Sam: action items: 1) Miguel to draft header + gateway transform proto (ETA 2d) 2) Priya to update SDK deprecationCallback + lint rule (ETA 1w) 3) Dana to author runbook and dashboard widgets (ETA 3d) 4) Sam to update RFC with cadence and publish changelog (ETA 2d).
Priya: noted. I'll also add a staging experiment to flip legacy-mode for a subset of tenants to validate shim correctness. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: deploy-bot automated message: staging toggle for ARCH-2026-042 enabled for 5% of tenants at 1768812380 by Sam.
Sam: thanks — we'll reconvene after the staging run. :eyes:
Miguel: one more note — prefer telemetry tag `dep_id` to correlate logs and traces easily.
Dana: ok saving this to the architecture deprecations board. anyone object to the cadence?
Priya: no objections from me.
Sam: no objections. closing for now, will follow up with PRs.
